doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Keith Ingham, arrangements and trio albums
summary: Ingham arranged the Crosby album, and Gordon, Hal Smith and Ingham made trio records; the trio format is demanding.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Oh, wow. I see you have worked with Keith Ingham. Am I pronouncing that right?
Okay. He’s done some arranging for you also? © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
Yes, he did the Bing Crosby album, the arrangements on that. And then Hal Smith, myself and Keith had made some trio albums together.
That takes a lot of piano playing, to do the trio thing, doesn’t it?
Yes it does. It takes a lot out of everybody to do that.
But Benny Goodman kind of did all right with it.
He could do it very nicely, yes.
